docs.summary: Omnidirectional point light with a finite range and pluggable attenuation curve.
World-space range. Past this distance the light contributes nothing.
Optional per-light attenuation override. When null, the scene's [`DefaultAttenuation`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.BakeScene~DefaultAttenuation) is used.

members.name: Sample
members.signature: public override bool Sample(Float3 position, out Float3 toLight, out Float3 radiance, out float maxDist, Sampling.IAttenuation defaultAttenuation)

docs.summary: Sample the irradiance arriving at `position` from this light along `toLight`. Returns false if the light contributes nothing (out of range, outside cone, behind). The shadow ray (origin, target, maxDist) is filled regardless.
